title: requiredWhen is still judged against current values in three more form doors: the edit wizard, the console FormPage, and the kanban drop prompt
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnE9YNkSZen7sijLA3

Filing gate: class a (a user-visible defect, reached through public doors). The dev of PR #30216 (#30184) reported it in `open_questions` and `out_of_scope_findings`. The seat carries it, because devs do not file. ⛔ Not a claim. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes this card.

This is the **family closing card**. One card covers every site, listed below.

## Business reason

#30184 fixes the record **Edit form**. A record already inside a `requiredWhen` gate (an activated contract with no signed copy) now saves an unrelated edit, as the engine allows. Three other doors still judge the field as plainly required against the current values, so the same record stays locked there.

## Sites (dev's code reading on `31fe289f`; not seat-verified)

1. **Edit wizard.** `WizardForm`'s cross-step final gate (`gateFinalSubmit`) passes no stored row, so an Edit wizard on a record already in the gate is refused. Its note says the persisted record is deliberately not bound there (objectui#8069 ruling, option D). The dev proposes passing the stored row only to the stored-row check (`requiredWhenRestsOnStoredRecord`), not as the live `previous` binding. The fixer must show this is not the "new binding pipeline" that ruling refused. If it is, stop and ask.
2. **Console FormPage.** `resolveRowState` (Edit via `/forms/:name?recordId=`) passes the stored row but no `statics.name`, so it keeps the plain verdict.
3. **Kanban drop prompt.** `plugin-kanban` `collectRequiredWhenPromptFields` asks for a field the engine lets rest.

## Governing rule

The engine's `requiredWhen` is a transition gate. `packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts` refuses an update only when the merged record violates the rule **and** the stored row complied (the ADR-0113 non-regression block, `preViolated`). #30184 (PR #30216) mirrors this on the Edit form through `resolveFieldRuleState`'s `requiredWhenAtRest`. Each site above should read that same verdict and not write a second rule.

## Dedupe

`requiredWhen wizard`, `requiredWhen kanban` and `requiredWhen FormPage` (open and closed) found no card for these sites. The nearest is #30184 itself. **New.**

## Re-check

`git grep -n "collectRequiredWhenPromptFields\|gateFinalSubmit" origin/main -- ui/packages`
